international.title: People behind Leave.EU and Vote Leave launch new incarnations of pro-Brexit campaigns
international.summary: Andy Wigmore says he wants his Enough Official group to join forces with Michael Gove-backed Stay Out movement The Brexit wars were a bitter period in political history, fraught with tension and badmouthing – and that was just between the different Leave campaigns. Now as a new incarnation of Dominic Cummings’ Vote Leave looks set to re-enter the political fray, so too does a rival anti-EU campaign from the team behind Leave.EU, who ran their own unofficial campaign backed by Nigel Farage.
